title: NodeContribution
description: Canonical envelope for one @node contribution inside a K'UHUL @fold. A Micronaut response is the accumulation of these contributions.

node_name.description: Human-readable node name, e.g. hypothesis, contradiction, evidence.

neighborhood.description: Semantic neighborhood, e.g. THOUGHT, FAMILY, EMOTION, SPACE.

subject.description: Micronaut subject this contribution is attached to.

capability.description: Capability tag for downstream grouping. Not a runtime authority.

recognition.description: What input pattern triggered this node.

captures.description: Named capture slots extracted from the input.

relations.description: Semantic relation triples asserted by this node.

evidence.description: Evidence references (artifact ids, memory ids, facts).

input_state.description: Input state snapshot before this node fired.

output_state.description: Output state after this node fired.

source.description: Source label, e.g. node-engine, legacy-eliza, persona.

provenance_hash.description: Deterministic hash of node + match + input for replay verification.

text.description: Default display text: the articulation produced by this node.
